title: Split a User Directory
short_description: Practice separating responsibilities between a container and a presentational component.
description: App.vue already controls directory search and selection.
Complete the UserList.vue contract and connect both components through props and events.
instructions: In UserList.vue, declare users as a required Array prop.
In UserList.vue, declare the select event.
In App.vue, pass filteredUsers to the UserList users prop.
In App.vue, listen for select and run selectUser with the emitted identifier.

hints.title: Presentational contract
hints.body: UserList must declare users with defineProps and select with defineEmits.

hints.title: Downward flow
hints.body: Use :users to pass filteredUsers from App.vue.

hints.title: Upward flow
hints.body: Listen for @select in App.vue and pass selectUser as its handler.
